scope: Explicit -B for five isolated Python launches importing packaged application source; no native launcher or processing behavior changes.
before_regression: The initial imaging/planar capability regression executed actual copied-runtime subprocesses and failed because they created runtime/__pycache__. Its raw expected failure is preserved unchanged. The final regression was expanded to actual lens and, where NumPy is available, roto workers.
after_regression: Eight focused tests passed with no skips/errors/failures. This includes the expanded copied-runtime preservation regression and real affine/projective measurement. The pinned verification runtime supplies NumPy so the actual roto worker ran.
acceptance_boundary: Local regression evidence. It does not substitute for the subsequent frozen full suite, installation, or canonical installed native launch.
